name: Hybrid Volume Rendering with Hierarchical Representation
aliases: Smooth Transition between Splatting and Raycasting
definition: A hardware-accelerated hybrid volume rendering scheme that provides a smooth transition between texture-based (raycasting) and point-based (splatting) techniques by dividing the volumetric dataset into hierarchical nodes, each rendered with the most efficient method based on a division criterion.
summary: Hybrid Volume Rendering with Hierarchical Representation is a hardware-accelerated scheme that smoothly transitions between splatting and raycasting by dividing datasets into octree nodes, minimizing popping artifacts while optimizing performance.
